measured_findings.observed: With explicit adapter phases, farmer (3/3), candymaker (4/4), ballerina (3/3), detective (3/3) had no mapped stations; painter had 2/3 unmapped, popstar 1/4, astronaut 2/4. Chef mapped all 5/5. Corresponding no-authored-room warnings appeared in the labeled log.
measured_findings.expected: Every phase that uses room navigation should resolve to its intended authored landmark; phases intentionally using a non-station interaction need an explicit supported route so they do not remain unarmed. The source comment states there is no sequential fallback and unmapped phases remain unarmed.
